newsitem.title: ESTONIA: HANSATEE TO ISSUE NEW SHARES - REPORT.
newsitem.headline: HANSATEE TO ISSUE NEW SHARES - REPORT.

text.p: Shareholders of Hansatee, an unlisted Estonian shipping company, voted to increase the company's share capital by 20 million kroons on Wednesday, Aripaev business paper said.
The share issue will reduce the Estonian Shipping Company's (ESCO) holding in Hansatee from 45 percent to only one percent, the paper added. ESCO will be privatised shortly.
After the share issue the controlling stake in Hansatee will be held by Inforte Ltd with 66 percent and a subsidiary of Union Bank, Uhisinvesteeringud, with 32 percent, the paper added.
